levels.name: Mapped
levels.summary: The compliance program is mapped to a named CLHEAR release, profile and agnostic blueprint: every blueprint item is either operated with a named owner or declared out of scope with a reason.

levels.name: Traceable
levels.summary: CL1, and every operated item carries evidence traceable to the obligations it satisfies; deviations from the blueprint's characteristics are recorded with rationale; CLHEAR releases are tracked and reconciled within 30 days.

levels.name: Assessed
levels.summary: CL2, assessed by an accredited independent assessor: the mapping's completeness, the traceability of evidence and the operation of items over a period of at least six months.

levels.name: Automated
levels.summary: CL3, and the program is kept current by machine: releases consumed through the API or SDK against a pinned release, blueprint diffs ingested automatically, evidence produced continuously by systems, deviations alerting within 24 hours.

criteria.title: Named release
criteria.requirement: The self-assessment names the CLHEAR release the program is mapped to.
criteria.evidence: Release id (clhear-vYYYY.MM.DD or a nightly stamp) as shown at /v1/releases.

criteria.title: Named profile and blueprint
criteria.requirement: The program is composed from a stored L4 profile and its current L6 agnostic blueprint (BLU- id). The organisation confirms the profile's predicates describe it.
criteria.evidence: Blueprint id; a signed statement that the profile predicates (jurisdictions, licences, products, client types, channels) are accurate.

criteria.title: Scope statement
criteria.requirement: The assessed scope names the legal entities, business lines and jurisdictions covered, and any exclusions with reasons.
criteria.evidence: Scope statement in the form.

criteria.title: Complete blueprint
criteria.requirement: The blueprint covers 100 % of the obligations applicable to the profile (the L6 completeness gate) in the named release.
criteria.evidence: The blueprint's coverage summary as published by CLHEAR.

criteria.title: Every item mapped
criteria.requirement: Every item of the blueprint is mapped to a program element the organisation operates, or declared out of scope with a reason.
criteria.evidence: The item mapping in the form: for each ITM- id, status operated | out_of_scope and, for out_of_scope, a reason.

criteria.title: Named owners
criteria.requirement: Every operated item has a named accountable owner (a role, not necessarily a person).
criteria.evidence: Owner per operated item.

criteria.title: Out-of-scope items justified
criteria.requirement: Out-of-scope declarations are justified by a fact about the organisation (no such activity, entity or product) — never by a judgement that the obligation does not matter.
criteria.evidence: Reasons in the mapping; the program reviews them.

criteria.title: Evidence per item
criteria.requirement: Every operated item names at least one evidence artefact showing the item exists and operates (policy document, procedure record, system configuration, appointment letter, committee minutes).
criteria.evidence: Evidence references (document id, system, URL or file hash) per operated item, following the evidence templates in conformance/evidence_templates/.

criteria.title: Evidence traces to obligations
criteria.requirement: Each evidence artefact can be traced to the obligations the blueprint item satisfies (the item's obligations_satisfied), so a reviewer can go from evidence to verbatim source in one step.
criteria.evidence: Evidence references carry the obligation ids they evidence, or the artefact itself cites them.

criteria.title: Characteristics compared
criteria.requirement: For every operated item, the organisation compares its own characteristics (cadence, approver, retention, threshold …) with the blueprint's and records each deviation with a rationale.
criteria.evidence: Deviation register in the form.

criteria.title: Release tracking
criteria.requirement: The organisation tracks CLHEAR releases and change events for its profile (watchlist, change feed or SDK) and can show the last release reconciled.
criteria.evidence: Watchlist id / feed subscription; last reconciled release.

criteria.title: Reconciliation window
criteria.requirement: Changes to the blueprint (new, changed or retired items) are reconciled into the program within 30 days of the release.
criteria.evidence: Declared reconciliation window ≤ 30 days; a reconciliation log.

criteria.title: Annual review
criteria.requirement: The mapping, exclusions and deviation register are reviewed at least annually and on material change to the organisation's profile, with the review recorded.
criteria.evidence: Review record (date, reviewer role, outcome).

criteria.title: Accountable signatory
criteria.requirement: The self-assessment is signed by an accountable officer of the organisation (head of compliance or equivalent) who confirms its accuracy.
criteria.evidence: Signatory name, role, date.

criteria.title: Machine consumption
criteria.requirement: The program consumes CLHEAR through the API or SDK against a pinned release; the pinned release is upgraded through a controlled change.
criteria.evidence: Application key id; pinned release; change records for upgrades.

criteria.title: Automatic diff ingestion
criteria.requirement: Blueprint diffs between releases are ingested automatically and create work items without manual re-keying.
criteria.evidence: System records showing diff → work item; assessor re-performs on a sample.

criteria.title: Continuous evidence
criteria.requirement: Evidence for operated items is produced by systems on their own cadence (instance mode of a Reg42 OS deployment or an equivalent), not assembled for the assessment.
criteria.evidence: System-generated evidence with timestamps across the period.

criteria.title: Deviation alerting
criteria.requirement: A deviation between the program's characteristics and the blueprint, or a lapsed item, alerts an owner within 24 hours.
criteria.evidence: Alert configuration and a sample of alerts with response times.

criteria.title: Independent assessor
criteria.requirement: The assessment is performed by an assessor on the accredited register who is independent of the organisation and of Reg42 under the ISAE 3000 independence requirements.
criteria.evidence: Assessor register id; independence confirmation in the report.

criteria.title: Period of operation
criteria.requirement: The assessor tests the operation of a sample of items over a period of at least six months (ISAE 3000 reasonable assurance on operating effectiveness).
criteria.evidence: Period stated in the report; sampling approach; exceptions and their disposition.

criteria.title: Report form
criteria.requirement: The report follows conformance/ASSESSOR_GUIDE.md § Report: subject matter, criteria (this Annex), period, opinion, exceptions, and the CLHEAR release and blueprint assessed.
criteria.evidence: Signed report lodged with the program.
